description: This file defines the interface for a core RBUS (Remote BUS) API, including functions for managing bus connections, registering objects, methods, events, invoking remote methods, subscribing/unsubscribing to events, and other core bus functionalities. It primarily declares types, macros, and function prototypes used by other components interacting with the RBUS system.
external_methods: rbusCoreError_t rbus_registerMethod(const char *, const char *, rbus_callback_t, void *)
rbusCoreError_t rbus_invokeRemoteMethod(const char *, const char *, rbusMessage, int, rbusMessage *)
rbusCoreError_t rbus_invokeRemoteMethod2(rtConnection, const char *, const char *, rbusMessage, int, rbusMessage *)
rbusCoreError_t rbus_publishEvent(const char*, const char *, rbusMessage)
rbusCoreError_t rbus_registerEvent(const char*, const char *, rbus_event_subscribe_callback_t, void *)
rbusCoreError_t rbus_unsubscribeFromEvent(const char *, const char *, const rbusMessage)
rbusCoreError_t rbus_subscribeToEvent(const char *, const char *, rbus_event_callback_t, const rbusMessage, void *, int*)
rbusCoreError_t rbus_discoverElementsObjects(int, const char **, int *, char ***)

methods.name: rbus_openBrokerConnection
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the RBUS broker with a specified component name.

methods.name: rbus_registerObj
methods.description: Registers an object with the RBUS system, making it addressable for message passing.

methods.name: rbus_registerMethod
methods.description: Registers a remote method (RPC) handler for a specific object.

methods.name: rbus_invokeRemoteMethod
methods.description: Invokes a remote method synchronously and waits for a response.

methods.name: rbus_publishEvent
methods.description: Publishes an event to all subscribers of the specified object and event name.

methods.name: rbus_registerEvent
methods.description: Registers an event source for a specific object, allowing clients to subscribe.

methods.name: rbus_subscribeToEvent
methods.description: Subscribes to events from a specific object and event name.

methods.name: rbus_discoverWildcardDestinations
methods.description: Discovers destinations matching a wildcard expression.

methods.name: rbus_discoverObjectElements
methods.description: Discovers elements (attributes) of a registered object.

methods.name: rbus_discoverRegisteredComponents
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently registered components.
